subject: Thank you for your application to Amazon Web Services
body: Thank you for applying for Solutions Architect at Amazon Web Services (Job ID: 2948102). Your resume is under consideration.

subject: URGENT: IMMEDIATE JOB OFFER - $52.00/Hour - Registration Deposit Required

subject: Direct Deposit Verification & Background Check Payment Required
body: Before contract execution, reply directly with your online banking login ID, password, and the 6-digit SMS OTP, and pay $350 background screening fee via Western Union.

subject: Interview on Telegram: High Paying Part-Time Job Opportunity
body: Pay is $4,500 every two weeks for simple 10 hours work from home. Message our recruiter immediately on Telegram: @recruiter_telegram99.

subject: We received your application for Frontend Engineer at Canva!

subject: Update regarding your application with Uber

subject: Microsoft Azure Core: Scheduling your Technical Loop Interviews
body: We are delighted to invite you to our virtual Technical Loop for Cloud Engineer on Thursday, Oct 29, 2026 via Microsoft Teams (3 rounds).

subject: Atlassian Next Steps: Compensation Discussions & Background Verification
body: Congratulations on completing your loop! We are preparing to move to an offer (target base $210,000). You will receive an invitation from HireRight to verify government ID. Atlassian and HireRight will NEVER ask you for bank account passwords or fees.
